content.text: {"core": "Abstraction pulls lived experience up into pattern — the specific becomes general, the general becomes principle. Seated in its own position, it works on thinking itself: the patterns that organize how patterns get made. Underdone, no distance forms between thing and thought. The particular floods, and what could teach by resemblance just accumulates.", "sheetLine": "Nothing lifts into pattern; each thing stays only itself."}
